historical_reviews.v3_1: A policy readback and a transport attempt are separate oracles: every disabled/enabled setting needs both, and the observer must avoid relying on the channel currently being disabled.

original_test_intent: Prove that the BMC SSH and Network IPMI access policies independently enforce rejection when disabled and permitted access when enabled.
original_method: Verify target and recovery path, snapshot both controls, then change only one control at a time. For each disabled state, read back the setting and make one bounded corresponding protocol attempt that must be refused; for each enabled state, read back and use the approved account for a bounded successful connection. Restore both original settings and revalidate management reachability.
manual_activity: The security owner identifies the supported policy fields, approved protocol sources and expected refusal signatures; the operator approves every access-control mutation, watches the independent recovery channel and owns the final verdict.
required_inputs: Supported SSH and Network-IPMI policy paths
Approved test account and protected credentials
Designated SSH and IPMI source hosts
Expected disabled refusal and enabled success signatures
Independent BMC Web or console recovery
safety_requirements: Never disable the only management or recovery path
Mutate only the named control and target
Use validated host/TLS identity and protected credential injection
Attempt each protocol once with bounded timeout and no retry storm
Do not infer enforcement from policy readback alone
Stop on cross-coupling, wrong-target response or access loss
Restore exact original states and preserve audit/SEL evidence
agent_execution_scope: Read identity and both policy baselines
Apply only approved SSH/IPMI policy changes
Perform one bounded protocol probe per state
Correlate policy readback with protocol outcome
Restore baseline and verify recovery access
Report evidence without deciding PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED
engineer_actions: Approve policy schema, test sources, identity and credential
Confirm restoration and assign PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Reading AccountService neither identifies the SSH/IPMI controls nor exercises their rejection or acceptance behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-supported Web/Redfish policy fields plus one bounded SSH client attempt and one bounded ipmitool request from approved hosts, sequencing one control at a time and restoring the baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both named protocols, disabled-then-enabled order and 15/15-minute estimates are preserved; endpoint and credentials remain Project inputs.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a four-line matrix containing control, requested state, confirmed readback, source host, bounded transport outcome and timestamp, while continuously verifying an independent recovery path.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target binding, cross-coupling detection, bounded probes and deterministic restoration without changing the four source checkpoints.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A settings-page or JSON snapshot proves configured intent only; actual SSH/IPMI refusal or success proves enforcement.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong-target writes or disabling coupled services may remove remote management; successful TCP connection alone may also be insufficient unless the approved authentication/command boundary is defined.

project_override_considerations: The Project must map the UI labels to authoritative firmware fields and define whether successful access means transport, authentication or one harmless command; no unrelated certificate operation belongs to this row.
expected_evidence: Verified target, approvals, source hosts, account, baseline controls and independent recovery proof
SSH Disabled write/readback plus one bounded rejected SSH result
Network IPMI Disabled write/readback plus one bounded rejected IPMI result
SSH Enabled write/readback plus approved bounded success
Network IPMI Enabled write/readback plus approved bounded success
Exact baseline restoration, recovery reachability, audit/SEL/security events and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define independent disable/reject and enable/allow checks for SSH and Network IPMI.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The policy schema, credentials, approved source hosts and recovery path are normal security-controlled inputs; their absence before execution does not make the review itself unresolved.

review_improvement: Replaces an unrelated inventory shortcut with the literal two-control enforcement matrix and makes safe recovery, readback and protocol-level evidence mandatory.
independent_technical_reasoning: Access-policy correctness has two layers: the configuration plane must persist the requested value and the data plane must enforce it for the matching protocol. Testing controls serially is necessary to expose accidental coupling and to retain a known-good recovery path; blind retries would increase lockout and audit noise without adding evidence.
